## To the full

**Word Power 29 · English idioms**

### Meaning

As much as possible; to the greatest possible degree.

### Usage

1. I've always believed in living life to the full.
2. Great people do everything with full involvement. They enjoy every moment to the full, be it working or playing.

### Your turn

Use “to the full” in a sentence of your own. The original lesson image also includes Hindi support and illustrations.
